messages:
maria: Quick sync — preflight for bcn-west-1 region cutover. Need owners for routing policy, KMS, DB replica, and canary window. https://go.redwood/internal/regions/bcn-west-1

sam: I can own routing policy + DNS failover. Will open PR for Route53 changes later today.

kevin: DB replica is blocked on cross-region replica quota with cloud infra. Filed ticket, ETA ~24h after infra approves. @sam can you confirm VPC peering will be ready?

sam: VPC peering is fine from our side. Will add required subnets to the PR — need subnet list from @maria.

maria: Pushing subnet list here: `subnet-bcn-a1, subnet-bcn-a2` — also need a customer-managed KMS key created. @jess any compliance requirements we should add to the keypolicy?

jess: KMS key ok but we must include ops-team IAM role in keypolicy and enable key rotation. I'll open a terraform PR and tag security reviewers.

deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: canary bcn-west-1 at 2024-08-07T02:00Z (window 02:00–04:00Z). Runbook: https://go.redwood/runbooks/region-cutover. Automated rollback enabled.

dina: Product 👍 on the canary window (works for EU hours). Please create a short rollback plan we can surface to CS.

maria: Draft rollback steps -> revert Route53 weights, drain & disable bcn nodes from LB, rollback infra#523 if needed. I'll add commands to the runbook.

sam: Ping on two PRs: `infra#523` (VPC peering + subnets) and `dns#211` (weighted routing). Can reviewers ack so we can merge before bake? :pray: 

kevin: Acked infra#523, left one minor comment about route table tags. dns#211 LGTM, merging after CI.

jess: KMS PR created: `security#88`. Added rotation and policy draft. Need @maria to add billing and project tags for audit.

maria: Billing tag added. Also who owns SLA matrix update for region latency/residency? Need console docs + SLO page updated.

dina: I’ll own the SLA matrix update and work with marketing on the console copy. Assign to me for final review.

sam: Quick smoke-test command to validate routing after canary start: ```curl -H 'Region: bcn-west-1' https://api.redwood.com/health/routing``` run from staging agent.

kevin: Will run smoke at T+15m after canary start and post the logs here (will include tracer IDs).

maria: Thanks everyone. Action items recap: sam (routing + dns PRs), kevin (DB replica + smoke), jess (KMS PR), dina (SLA/docs). I’ll update the tracking board and tag owners on the runbook. :thumbsup:
